tei:div.tei:p: skyabs rje si tu rin po che/ thub bstan sman ljongs kun tu rgyas pa'i gzhir// lam bzang 'jigs med snga 'gyur pad tshal du// bshad sgrub chos kyi rgya mtsho legs 'khyil ba// kun mkhyen mi pham mgon po 'tsho gzhes gsol/ bla ma 'brug pa rin po che/ kun khyab 'gyur med gnas lugs rig pa'i gshis// gzung 'dzin sna tshogs rtog pa'i mun pa las// rang grol gsang chen bstan pa'i nyi ma che/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po 'tsho gzhes gsol/ mkhan chen kun dpal/ bla ma'i bstan la thub pa'i mdzad pa can// kun bzang dri med 'od zer ring lugs 'chang*// chos kyi grags dang mkhyen rtogs dbyer med pa// mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa 'tsho gzhes gsol/ mkhan a ngag sras bcas rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i tshul// bslab gsum rnam dag khrims gtsang legs skyong zhing*// brtan mkhas yon tan rgya mtsho'i pha mthar son// mnyam med 60)'gro ba'i mgon po 'tsho gzhes gsol/ /bka' drin che ba'i bla ma dam pa rnams la zhabs pad yun du bzhugs pa'i smon tshig tu gsol ba dharma hastis so// ༈ kun khyab 'gyur med gnas lugs rig pa'i gshis// gzung 'dzin sna tshogs rtog pa'i mun pa las// rang grol gsang chen bstan pa'i nyi ma che// khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon por gsol ba 'debs// 'chi med rtag pa dam pa gnyug ma'i gshis// rang gzugs gzhom med 'pho chen dwangs ma'i sku// mi shig rdo rje'i chos bdun ngo bo ru// bstan 'gro'i don du bskal brgyar 'tsho gzhes 'tsho gsol// mu med srid par 'khyams pa'i yid can 'gro// tshad med thugs rje'i 'jug pas 'khor mtsho las// phyam gcig gdod ma'i sa la dbugs byung nas// don gnyis rtag khyab lhun gyis grub gyur cig /ces pa'ang go 'jo smon lam grags pa'i bzhed skong du dharma hastis rje de nyid kyi gdan sa 'od gsal theg mchog gling nas bris pa dge'o//

gsol 'debs/ zhabs brtan/ smon lam rnams la sho lo ka re re yod/ 61)༄༅/ phyag chen brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs nyung ngur bsdus pa bzhugs so/ na mo gu ru/ mi shigs rdo rje ting 'dzin rtag tu 'chang*// shes rab chen po rtogs pa'i dpal bzang po// lhan skyes ye shes mngon byas dngos grub brnyes// rgyal ba rgyal sras de sras gsum la 'dud// bka' bzhin chos la blo gros rab rgyas shing*// rdo rje'i sku thob rgyal ba'i mtshan dpe lhan// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs rin po che// gangs chen bstan pa'i sgron me gsum la 'dud// rang rig rdo rje ma rig las rgyal po// sgrib med shes rab mkha' la ye shes shar// mkhyen gnyis ye shes mngon gyur rgyal mtshan 'dzin// bsgrub rgyud bstan pa'i bdag nyid gsum la 'dud// byang chub sems dpa' chen por yongs grags pa// bsod nams las byung ye shes mthar phyin cing*// bstan pa rin chen mi nub rgyal mtshan bsgreng*// bla ma sprul pa'i skyes mchog gsum la 'dud// thugs rje'i 'od zer 'gro ba'i bla mar byon/ 62)/dkon mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs kun khyab// khyab brdal chos nyid mi 'gyur rdo rje rtogs// rtogs ldan 'gro ba'i mgon po gsum la 'dud// rang gnas ye shes rtogs pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin// thar pa'i rgyal mtshan mi yi seng ge'i gzugs// bla med dkon mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs// mtshungs med mkhas grub dam pa gsum la 'dud// dkon mchog kun 'dus bla ma rdo rje 'dzin// shākya'i bstan pa gsal byed rgyal ba'i mtshan// byang chub rkyen la mi 'jigs seng ge bzhin/ kha skong ni/ bya bral rnal 'byor dbang po gsum la 'dud// phan bde'i bkra shis rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab// ston pa'i rgyal tshab mi yi seng gi mchog chos nyid dgongs pa rnam mkhyen rgya mtshor 'khyil// sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i sgron me gsum la 'dud// ston pa mchog gi bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin// kun bzang khyad chos drug ldan shes rab brnyes// rtag khyab lhun grub phrin las rgya mtsho'i bdag

/snga 'gyur bstan pa'i 'byung gnas 63)gsum la 'dud// pad+ma'i rgyal tshab dgos 'byung nor bu'i dbyig /lung rtogs chos dpal mkhas btsun bzang po'i tog /karma chags bral don dam dgongs pa brnyes// phyag rdzogs bstan pa'i nyin byed gsum la 'dud// nges don rdzogs chen yang gsang bstan pa 'dzin// mdo sngags bka' gter bstan 'dzin yongs kyi gtso// chos kyi rgyal po phan bde'i nyi ma mchog /drin chen dpal ldan bla ma gsum la 'dud// de ltar bka' brgyud nor bu'i phreng ba la// dad mos gus pas gsol btab byin rlabs kyis// gnyis med phyag rgya chen po'i don rtogs nas// bka' brgyud khyed ltar bdag sogs 'gyur bar shog zhes pa kha skong 'di'ang phyag rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag brgyud pa gser gyi phreng ba'i gral mthar gnas pa chos kyi glang pos gsol ba btab pa dge bar gyur cig rdo rje 'chang chen te lo na ro dang*// mar pa mi la dwags po phag mo gru// smra pa yang dgon spyan snga dbu se ba// rin chen 'od zer rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ 64)/shing mgo chos rdor dzñā na byang sems rje// a rdo dkon mchog shākya byang chub sems// bkra shis ston pa chos nyid gser lo tsa// kun bzang shes rab rnams la= lhun grub nor bu chos dpal de wan+t+ra// nges don mdo sngags chos kyi nyi ma'i sde// bka' drin mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma rje// bka' brgyud nor bu'i phreng bar= go myong rtogs pas rtog med rtse gcig gnas// 'khor 'das chos kun stong nyid spros bral rtogs// yul dang yul can gnyis med ro gcig 'dres// sgom med chos sku'i rgyal sa zin par shog zhes pa'ang chos kyi glang pos bris pa dge//
